notes.title: Performance update and usability update!
notes.notes:
[b]A Performance and usability update![/b]
- Made trails cache when not in use, this should stop performance to degrade over long playtimes.
- Fixed a bug that spawned invisible items, that could have worsened performance a lot for long playtimes.
- Simplified physics for log dropping trees and items, so no potentially crazy behavior now.

- Added a gamepad controls help (hold gamepad special left to view)
- Fixed the "unstick player" tool, and moved it to a "HELP" menu with other useful commands to ease playing the game at this stage. 

- Added user adjustment option to[i] camera movement speeds[/i]. (in Options > Game)
- Disabled dev-menu by default (it can still be turned on in options.)

notes.title: Animation & Items Update!
notes.notes: [p][b]The new animations from my intern are now live for the game![/b][/p][p]She has worked fulltime for half a year on the game's animations and the animation system, so a lot of great progress has been made! Our character is more alive. Still, some animations aren't quite finished yet, and a bit blockouty, but the important groundwork is laid, to enable further fleshing out of the animations in the future. [/p][p]- New animations for all the movement.[/p][p]- New cool contextual movement and states. [/p][p]- You can now take your hood off or on, b'cause reasons.[/p][p]- Cool crawling animations from Isak.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761304/55c24e01453afe7921fd31ab63bfada74b27767c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Also new in this build are work done on the items.[/b][/p][p]You can now use the [b]tent, pelt, firewood[/b] also with [i]gamepad,[/i] as well as interacting with things like lights in the cabbin! Everything should be fully playable with both mouse or gamepad.[/p][p]The experience should be more refined with both mouse & gamepad. [/p][p]Remember you can both click as well as drag (or hold on gamepad) to interact, so look and listen for how things react.  [/p][p]note: the fire is still quite WIP and can be janky.[/p][p][/p][p]- Saving and loading should save all your items now aswell.[/p][p]- Audio sliders work now.[/p][p][/p][p]/V[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: GOOD NEWS
notes.notes:
I'm actually alive and making great progress, despite not updating Steam much. The game is starting to tell a full story - and it's going to get a real story.   

Also Big News: I'm joined for a time by an animator! She's gonna help put life and motion into the character and gameplay. But more about this later - that's for another update.

notes.title: Added a Save/Load system!
notes.notes:
Added a Save/Load system for the tracks. You have several slots and ALL the trails are saved, so bear that in mind. It's not a full save/load system yet: time and the items you place are not stored yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761304/3599840b224ae2ee6d25872c8814a162e380a155.jpg[/img]

Added a experimental "Guides" system. To help you draw in geometric shapes. It helps but doesn't do [i]all [/i]the work.
